reason: A DeepSeek Harness floating dashboard primarily visualizes agent workspaces, sessions, subagents, statuses, token usage, messages, and meetings, with optional local-script integrations for mail, Feishu/Lark data, calendars, and transcripts.

summaries.zh: 用于在悬浮办公室面板中可视化 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区、会话、子代理、令牌用量及可选的邮箱、飞书消息和会议数据。
summaries.en: A floating DeepSeek Harness office dashboard for visualizing workspaces, sessions, subagents, token usage, and optional mail, Feishu/Lark, and meeting data.

capabilities: Displays workspaces, sessions, subagents, statuses, and token usage in a dashboard
Reads and sends Agent Mail through the configured CLI
Executes configured local scripts to synchronize and read Feishu/Lark messages and calendars
Retrieves meeting transcripts through configured scripts and moves saved transcripts to a user-selected directory
Requests meeting-recording permissions when the configured permission script is enabled
